policy.disclaimer: EGLE guidance is a general collection limit, not proof that a specific operator/shoreline segment permits taking rocks. Verify posted and local regulations. Never route through private land.
policy.accessPolicies: Park address or beach centroid is NOT an exact entrance/parking route.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: 2475 M-119 Hwy; public park day-use beach house, beach and accessible waterfront walkway documented by DNR.
pilotReviews.parking: State-park day-use, Recreation Passport required for vehicle entry. Day-use lot coordinate not yet owner-verified.
pilotReviews.walking: DNR documents accessible walkway to waterfront from day-use area; no georeferenced route yet.
constraints: Piping-plover closures may affect shore sections
Beach and swimming areas require segment review
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Verify entrance and parking lot coordinate, usable beach segment and current local collecting restrictions.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: Bell's Bay Road, Charlevoix; DNR shoreline and trails on foot, but day-use areas closed to vehicle traffic during culvert repairs.
pilotReviews.parking: No legal alternate parking point verified while vehicle closure remains; do not give turn-by-turn.
pilotReviews.walking: DNR reports trails and shoreline still accessible by foot; length and entry from legal parking unverified.
constraints: Temporary vehicle closure at day-use areas
Primitive park sections and sensitive shore zones
Check DNR notice before travel
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Ask park to verify legal roadside parking/access during culvert works, reopening status and site-specific collecting constraints.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: City-operated public Lake Michigan beach at west end of Main Street, Frankfort. City 2022–2026 recreation plan documents ADA walkways.
pilotReviews.parking: City planning materials describe beach parking off Main Street / Father Marquette Drive; exact present lot and regulations require current confirmation.
pilotReviews.walking: Public access from west end of Main Street; no surveyed path coordinates.
constraints: Rock/fossil occurrence mentioned by EGLE, not permission for extraction
Pier is not a safe rock search route
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Confirm current city beach parking, municipal collecting ordinance and path to legitimate beach segment.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: Official township public Agate Beach, accessible via N. Lake Avenue at the end of downtown's main street; township maintains boardwalk/deck.
pilotReviews.parking: Township planning documents discuss existing paved beach parking; legal/current lot details must be verified with township.
pilotReviews.walking: Public boardwalk to lake confirmed by township; 2026 renovation bid contemplated replacing steps with accessible ramp. Do not assert ramp is complete.
constraints: Agate Beach access deck 2026 renovation status unknown
No ADA ramp completion confirmation
Collecting must not extend into NPS shoreline without separate rule
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Confirm parking entrance/gate pin and completion/closure of deck renovation and current municipal collection rules.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: Official Bayshore Park at Grand Marais harbor; municipal beach/bathhouse/parking/playground.
pilotReviews.parking: Township confirms public park; Michigan Water Trails lists parking, public restrooms and shore access under 50 yards; specific space unknown.
pilotReviews.walking: Direct park-to-beach walking access described; exact trail and shore segment not georeferenced.
constraints: Municipal swimming beach, not independently validated as agate deposit
Sheltered harbor is negative control; waves on open coast must not be inferred here
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Confirm municipality collecting allowance; do not use park GPS as parking entrance. Trace shoreline beyond mapped beach polygon.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: 18350 Highway M-203 Hancock; state park public Lake Superior beach and day-use waterfront.
pilotReviews.parking: Recreation Passport for vehicle access; DNR does not identify exact research-area parking in source.
pilotReviews.walking: DNR's accessibility guide confirms accessible waterfront walkway; route geometry not yet traced.
constraints: No validated rock-specific section or shoreline normal
Lake Superior safety hazards may override conditions
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Identify DNR parking-to-water exact path, segment accessibility, and local collecting exclusions.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: 3582 State Park Drive Bay City; day-use swim beach and seasonal coastal boardwalk/beach mat.
pilotReviews.parking: Recreation Passport for vehicle access; park day-use parking exists, exact entrance unverified.
pilotReviews.walking: DNR confirms coastal boardwalk and seasonal mat to buoyed beach; route not digitized.
constraints: Wetland habitat around Tobico Marsh
Primarily sandy Saginaw Bay shore negative-control
Seasonal beach mat not year-round
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Verify accessible beach entry, collecting exclusions and rock-bearing sediment evidence (currently absent).

pilotReviews.accessDescription: 686 Tawas Beach Road East Tawas; day-use parking and Lake Huron beach house; Tawas Bay campground-side shore separate.
pilotReviews.parking: DNR day-use lot close to Lake Huron shoreline; Recreation Passport required.
pilotReviews.walking: Day-use Lake Huron beach and Tawas Bay-side beach documented; no mapped entrances/path coordinates.
constraints: Lighthouse/headland habitat and shore access may vary
Lake Huron and Tawas Bay must be separate geospatial segments
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Digitize both shore sides, check local rules and map lot to each segment.

pilotReviews.accessDescription: DNR day-use area coordinate 43.105475,-82.488804, separated ~1 mile from campground street address at 7605 Lakeshore Road.
pilotReviews.parking: Day-use area operates Memorial Day–Labor Day. Campground entrance cannot be substituted for day-use navigation.
pilotReviews.walking: DNR describes a pedestrian overpass, a rocky Lake Huron shore and an accessible walkway; route not digitized.
constraints: Day-use area seasonal closure outside Memorial Day–Labor Day
Campground and day-use locations different
pilotReviews.verificationNeed: Confirm any off-season public shore entrance, day-use gate pin, parking and site-specific collecting rule.
